_handoff_brief.step_2_strip_todo_markers: Remove lines from _notes array: 'WSP (WOW Sound Pixel Magic SFX Pack) rows are COMMENTED-NOT-WIRED pending Q-MATT-AUDIO-1 ($49 authorization).' and 'TODO(drax): when WSP acquired (Q-MATT-AUDIO-1), replace Leohpaz/TomMusic primary entries with WSP paths for fire/water/earth/wind/lightning/shadow/holy elements.' — replace with completion-record note: 'WSP wired 2026-05-1X by drax v1.1X per elrond manifest wsp-layer-1-upgrade-manifest-2026-05-18.jsonl (Q-MATT-AUDIO-1 $49 resolved).'
_handoff_brief.step_3_red_cell_resolution_notes: Update _notes RED-cell entry — TWO RED cells RESOLVED by WSP: water+slam (PM_ELEM_Ice04_Avalanche.wav) + holy+slam (PM_ELEM_Light07_Resurrect_FULL.wav). Remaining RED cells: earth+beam (still composite-construction; Leohpaz Earth fallback retained) + physical+beam + physical+aura (both unchanged — Cluster D foley territory).
_handoff_brief.step_4_loudness_normalization: WSP source files are 24-bit 96kHz stereo (verified). Loudness norm needed at integration: (a) WSP delivered samples are typically -9 to -11 LUFS short-term (commercial pack norm — louder than canon § 5.1 Layer-1 target -12 LUFS). Apply -1 to -3 dB pre-gain at integration. Two options: (a1) batch ffmpeg-loudnorm to -12 LUFS before drop into final paths, OR (a2) apply per-bus gain offset in Howler.js GainNode chain at runtime. Recommendation: (a2) runtime gain — preserves source-pack file integrity for future re-mastering + faster integration. Reverse if mobile CPU budget reveals runtime-gain regression. (b) True-peak cap -1.0 dBTP — verify post-gain at integration; WSP impact transients may need brick-wall limiter. (c) For *_beam loop files (PM_ELEM_Fire08_Flamethrower_Loop, etc.): verify seamless loop boundaries — trim 5-10ms head/tail if clicks detected. (d) Format: WSP ships .wav 24-bit 96kHz; current manifest uses .wav/.ogg mixed. Drax may transcode to .ogg for browser-load efficiency (~3-5x file size reduction; Howler.js supports both). Recommend keeping .wav for v1.18 ship-quick + transcode to .ogg in v1.19 mobile-polish if mobile bundle-size flags it.
_handoff_brief.step_5_smoke_verification: Manual playtest: launch dev demo, fire one ability per element from each archetype slot. Verify: (1) WSP sound fires (not Leohpaz fallback); (2) register-coherence — all 7 magic elements feel like the same audio family (no register-bleed from Leohpaz/TomMusic remnants); (3) loudness — no element jumps -3+dB louder than peers; (4) holy element specifically — confirm bell-chime/cathedral-shimmer signature feels right; if too 'choir-ish' or off-register, fall back to canon § 3.2 Path 1 composite (WS3 Light + Kenney impactBell). (5) Phase-decomposed slots (water_projectile, fire_beam, shadow_area) — verify drax wiring picks composite-FULL form unless phase-trigger logic specifically requested. (6) Polyphony cap (canon § 5.4 — 8 simultaneous) — fire AOE in 5-enemy room; confirm no audio-engine glitches.
_handoff_brief.step_6_per_emitter_mix_bus: Canon § 6 same-file player/enemy convention preserved — WSP files route through playerSfxBus or enemySfxBus per emitter param (canon § 6.4 GainNode chain). No file duplication. Same WSP_ELEM_Fire03_Fireball_FULL plays from both player and enemy emitter contexts with different pan/reverb/EQ profiles.
_handoff_brief.step_7_star_lord_telemetry_check: Per canon § 9.4 — verify music_silent_fallback_fired counter remains zero post-WSP (no regression). Optionally instrument audio_layer1_asset_loaded counter to confirm WSP coverage rate (% of cast events firing WSP path vs Leohpaz fallback).
_handoff_brief.step_8_register_attention_zone_resolutio: Audio canon § 3.2 register-attention-zone for holy — WSP supplies retro-pixel holy directly. Canon § 3.2 Path 1 composite-construction (WS3 Light + Kenney bell-chime + pitch-shift) NO LONGER REQUIRED for normal operation. Path 1 recipe remains documented in original audio-substrate-subset-vs2a manifest as fallback.
